Additionally, benzyl benzoate is linked to 3-keto-steroid reductase, a target of azelaic acid, which also interacts with the same transporter. Furthermore, benzyl benzoate is associated with the interferon alpha/beta receptor (IFNAR), which is a target of Bafilomycin A1, another compound that interacts with the same transporter. These findings collectively imply that benzyl benzoate may influence the activity of the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1 through various molecular mechanisms, possibly by modulating signaling pathways or enzyme activity. The evidence is supported by multiple indirect pathways, but the strength of the connection remains uncertain due to the complexity of the biological interactions involved.
